lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in approximately three horizontal rows along the posterior flank, with one row clearly following the path of the lateral ridge toward the caudal peduncle.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible along the mid-lateral flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity pixel values on the upper surface to deep shadow on the lower surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The upper lobe of the caudal fin contains a distinct arrangement of high-contrast white spots, notably a triangular grouping of three spots near the dorsal apex.
